## What it is

changedetection.io checks web pages on a schedule and alerts you when their content changes: price drops, restocks, news or document updates ([dgtlmoon/changedetection.io](https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io)).

**Licence:** `Apache-2.0` (GitHub licence API; license-matrix row "changedetection.io"). Market class **L1**.

**Icon:** a neutral generated icon with initials; no upstream logo is shipped.

## Market listing

- Category and sub-tags (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1): news: change-detection. The sub-tags go into `metadata.tags` once the schema has it.
- Deployment class (TAXONOMY §2): **Market · community** until CI writes a passing scan (contract §9.4), then Market · verified if every check passes.

## How it runs here

- One `Deployment` (`Recreate`), one container, as UID 1000. The upstream entrypoint does not switch users, so no root step is needed. No privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped.
- Volume: `changedetection-data` (2 GiB, `/datastore`): watches, snapshots and settings.
- Probes: `GET /` on port 5000.
- Plain HTTP fetching only. The Playwright/Chrome fetcher (needed for pages built by JavaScript, and for screenshots) is a separate upstream service and is not packaged.

## First run

Source: [the upstream wiki](https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/wiki).

1. Install changedetection.io from the Market and approve the action. It installs into `app-changedetection`.
2. Forward the port and open http://localhost:5000:
   ```sh
   kubectl -n app-changedetection port-forward svc/changedetection 5000:5000
   ```
3. There is no password by default. Open Settings and set one before adding watches.
4. Add a URL to watch. Notifications use Apprise URLs; an ntfy app on the same box works as a target.

## Not done yet

- The Playwright browser fetcher is not packaged.
- No HTTPS or LAN hostname: OneMind v0 has no ingress or certificates for apps, so the web UI is reached through a port-forward until the app proxy exists.
- `readOnlyRootFilesystem` is not set: it has not been tested against this image.
- Resource figures are OneMind choices; upstream publishes none. They are checked against real use when the CI smoke test (contract §9.4 check 9) runs.
- `metadata.tier` stays `community` until `sdk/tools/app-gate` in CI writes a passing `scan.json`. `spec.updates.automerge` is `none` until `renovate.json` lists the app.
